wiki.title: Christine Sinicki
wiki.extract: Christine M. Sinicki (née Harling; born March 28, 1960) is an American Democratic politician from Milwaukee, Wisconsin. She is a member of the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing the 20th Assembly district in southeast Milwaukee County since 1999. She is also chair of the Democratic Party of Milwaukee County, since 2021.
